intro.desserts: North African pastries and homemade treats.
intro.boissons: Mint tea, cherbette and cold drinks.

house.title: Light grains, and a broth that took its time
paragraphs: The semolina is steamed, then worked by hand so it stays light, grain by grain.
The broth simmers with carrots, courgettes, turnips, pumpkin, chickpeas and raisins.
Then pick your meat: tender lamb neck, merguez, leg-of-lamb skewers or chicken. Or all three, if you're hungry.

infos.title: In central Amiens, on rue Saint-Jacques
infos.accessText: Right in the centre, a few minutes' walk from the cathedral and the Saint-Leu quarter.
infos.accessibilityText: The dining room is wheelchair accessible.
infos.hoursNote: Hours may change over the holidays and during Ramadan: the banner at the top of the page will tell you.

items.a: Yes, all our meat is halal: lamb, chicken and merguez. And we don't serve alcohol.
It's a good idea, especially on Friday evenings and at weekends. Book online or call us on +33 9 78 81 28 24.
Yes, for family meals, birthdays or work outings. Send a group request with the number of people and we'll call you back to arrange the table.
Yes, through Uber Eats and Deliveroo, within Amiens. For takeaway, call us and come and collect your order.

items.q: How does Too Good To Go work?
items.a: At the end of service we offer surprise bags with what's left of the day, at a small price. Reserve yours in the Too Good To Go app, then collect it at the time shown.
You pay at the restaurant: there's no online payment. For delivery, Uber Eats also accepts meal vouchers.
Yes: the vegetable couscous, fries and several sweets. Tell us about any allergy and we'll point you to what suits you.
